points.quote: Academic Integrity: Using AI to do your work for you (e.g. writing full essays) may breach university policies. Always check with your tutor.
points.gist: Using AI to do your work for you, such as writing full essays, may breach university policies; always check with your tutor.

points.quote: Accuracy: AI can sound confident but still give you incorrect or misleading information. Always fact-check.
points.gist: AI can sound confident but give incorrect or misleading information, so always fact-check.

points.quote: Over-reliance: it is a tool, not a replacement for learning. Relying too much on AI can limit your development of key academic skills.
points.gist: AI is a tool, not a replacement for learning, and relying too much on it can limit development of key academic skills.

points.quote: Bias and gaps: AI is trained on existing data, which can include biases or outdated views.
points.gist: AI is trained on existing data, which can include biases or outdated views.

points.quote: Writing support: AI can help with grammar, spelling, and sentence structure by suggesting alternatives.
points.gist: AI can help with grammar, spelling and sentence structure by suggesting alternatives.
